description: K₃Na(SeO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.35 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.59-3.08 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra. There are four shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-38°. There is one shorter (1.64 Å) and three longer (1.66 Å) Se-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three K and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three K, one Na, and one Se atom.
